event_definition.contact: continuous downward crossing from z>plane to z<=plane on a usable RK4 segment
event_definition.residence: linear RK segment time inside destination box after contact; right-censored if no return
event_definition.return: continuous downward crossing after upward event from z>plane to z<=plane
event_definition.unusable_segment: no event update; query becomes permanent_unknown
event_definition.upward: continuous upward crossing after contact from z<=plane to z>plane

material_reliability_status: uncalibrated; support_unknown is not material reliability

s2.residence_metric: cumulative destination-box time within observed window

s4.residence_metric: cumulative destination-box time within observed window

support_and_material_policy.event_cdf_bounds: finite event times are observed; unresolved permanent_unknown seeds enter the upper CDF from the preceding committed frame; reliable no-event seeds remain right-censored
support_and_material_policy.eventual_residence: right-censored beyond the observed window when contact occurred without return; no post-window value is imputed
support_and_material_policy.material_reliability: not inferred from numerical support mask or CDF agreement
support_and_material_policy.residence_cdf_bounds: all source mass is included; each seed contributes a cumulative observed-window residence interval [lower, upper], with zero for reliable no-contact seeds and conservative remaining-window upper mass after support loss
support_and_material_policy.support_unknown: permanent_unknown after a failed numerical RK stage; retained in 512 denominator
support_and_material_policy.t2: not evaluated; 0.3 s source is a short canary and not the registered 4.34 s qualification window
support_and_material_policy.unknown_endpoint_bounds: known reliable endpoint mass is a lower bound; permanent_unknown mass is added only to the upper bound
